title: Why Herman Heunis Sold Mxit at Its Peak, and What Came After
conflicts: User numbers range from 42m (Heunis via Fin24) and 43m registered (2011 reports) to 50m (iAfrikan) and 88m (Bizcommunity); story uses the contemporary 43m registered and the company's own 2014/2015 SA monthly-active figures. Sale price undisclosed (R500m called a rumour by Knott-Craig), so omitted. Founding year 2003 vs 2005 avoided. Final closure 30 September 2016 (iafrica notice) vs 24 September (Wikipedia); story says only 2016.
notes: Heunis sold four years before the closure, so the episode is his 2011 decision to sell while burnt out, followed through the 2012 retrenchments (about 40 of 150 staff) to the 2015 commercial closure and his 2015 tweet. An Africa-ME quote calling the sale 'traumatic' had no traceable original and was not used. Heunis died in 2022; not mentioned in the story.
